fields.description: Upload a cookies.txt exported from a logged-in YouTube browser session (e.g. the "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension). YouTube shows "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" for servers on datacenter IPs; a cookies file is the reliable fix.
fields.label: YouTube cookies.txt

fields.description: Optional HTTP/SOCKS proxy to download through a different IP, e.g. http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://host:port.
fields.label: Proxy URL

fields.options: These settings are used for every extraction. A cookies file alone is usually enough; set a proxy as well if the server IP stays blocked. Site-config values (hees_sola_cookiefile, hees_sola_proxy) take precedence when set.
